final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts), paired AS (SELECT c.record_count, c.record_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.record_count, p.share, p.record_count - m.average_count AS excess FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m WHERE m.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.record_count > m.average_count) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM kept
